# Data Integrity Checklist: Product Line B Onboarding Smoke

**Purpose**: Validate Product Line B data-integrity requirements before task generation, focused on Product Line A isolation, Product Line B seed idempotency, no-mutation preflight, existing-target behavior, cleanup counters, and snapshot/hash evidence.
**Created**: 2026-06-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are Product Line A isolation surfaces fully enumerated for workspace identity, projects, assignments, workflow templates, governance defaults, tasks/evidence/read-model rows, GitHub sync/lifecycle rows, counters, and non-owned flags? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK002 Are no-mutation preflight requirements defined with comparable before/after target evidence and an explicit non-mutating result state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are Product Line B seed idempotency requirements for repeated `apply` and `verify` on an already valid target explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Contract seed-product-line-cli]
- [ ] CHK004 Are existing-target outcomes separated for absent/ready Product Line B, already valid Product Line B, Product Line B residue, `plb-platform-*` conflicts, and Product Line A ownership conflicts? [Completeness, Contract seed-product-line-cli]
- [ ] CHK005 Are cleanup counter requirements complete for final disabled state, smoke-owned flags, repo sync ownership, eligible smoke work, unintended side effects, Product Line A parity, and retained evidence rationale? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Spec §SC-005]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is Product Line A snapshot/hash scope clear that whole-database counts alone are insufficient and expected Product Line B rows are excluded from drift? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK007 Are permitted Product Line A differences narrowly defined as explicitly named read-only inspection timestamps or logs? [Clarity, Contract scoped-dashboard-evidence]
- [ ] CHK008 Is Product Line B disabled lifecycle state unambiguous across seed/apply, temporary smoke enablement, final disablement, and verify? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK009 Are retained FocusEngine/OpenClaw identities clearly classified as inventory versus blocking Product Line B conflicts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do seed CLI requirements remain consistent with the resolved three-mode `preflight|apply|verify` boundary and avoid adding `enable` or `disable` seed modes? [Consistency, Contract seed-product-line-cli]
- [ ] CHK011 Do synthetic issue requirements align with disabled Product Line B GitHub sync ownership and the no-required-live-GitHub-write boundary? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK012 Do logical `plb-platform-*` assignment requirements stay consistent with the rule that harness manifest IDs are read-only substrate evidence only? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can preflight readiness, stop states, and no-mutation proof be objectively verified through stated result fields and snapshot parity? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK014 Can disabled-by-default and final-disablement outcomes be objectively verified with non-null `disabled_at`, false/absent flags, zero sync owner rows, and zero eligible smoke work? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK015 Can Product Line A isolation be objectively verified with scoped before/after hashes and scoped dashboard metrics where dashboard assertions are used? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK016 Can each smoke evidence phase be traced to command, SQL, API, or file evidence without rerunning hidden setup assumptions? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-007]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are residue and ownership conflict stop requirements defined before mutation for existing `product-line-b`, conflicting `plb-platform-*` assignments, repo sync ownership, and Product Line A takeover risks? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are cleanup failure and Product Line B left-enabled outcomes required to report incomplete closeout instead of claiming success? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are optional live GitHub evidence outcomes bounded so missing credentials, insufficient permission, or operator refusal stay non-mutating and do not fail the required synthetic smoke? [Edge Case, Spec §Clarifications]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK020 Are SPEC-010A seeder reuse and existing `workspaces.disabled_at` assumptions documented as prerequisites for the data-integrity approach? [Dependency, Plan §Research]
- [ ] CHK021 Are SPEC-014C file-ownership boundaries stated so data-integrity evidence cannot widen into adapter/runtime-inventory mutation? [Dependency, Spec §FR-011]

## Remediation Recheck

- [ ] CHK022 Do the updated requirements explicitly define repeated Product Line B `apply` and `verify` behavior for an already valid target? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK023 Does the seed CLI contract define the existing-target allowance path and refusal result for repeated Product Line B apply? [Clarity, Contract seed-product-line-cli]
- [ ] CHK024 Does the seed CLI contract distinguish absent/ready, already valid, residue-blocked, and ownership-conflict target classes before mutation? [Coverage, Contract seed-product-line-cli]
- [ ] CHK025 Does the quickstart require evidence for existing-target refusal, allowed repeated apply, stable snapshots, and read-only repeated verify? [Acceptance Criteria, quickstart]
